final: WITH product_volumes AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS volume FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, volume, volume / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(volume) FROM product_volumes), 0) AS share FROM product_volumes), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM product_shares) SELECT SUM(ps.volume) AS combined_order_volume, AVG(ps.share) AS average_share, AVG(ps.share - a.share) AS average_share_above_all_products FROM product_shares AS ps CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE ps.share > a.share
